intro.title: Complete Visibility of Your IT Inventory
paragraphs: Laptops get handed over without records, software licenses expire or sit unused, warranties lapse unnoticed, and nobody is sure how many devices the company actually owns. IT asset management (ITAM) software solves this by keeping one accurate, always up-to-date register of your hardware, software, licenses and contracts.

Our IT asset management system discovers devices on your network, tags them with barcodes or QR codes, assigns them to employees and locations, and tracks every change through the full asset lifecycle: procurement, deployment, maintenance, upgrades, retirement and secure disposal. IT teams get alerts for expiring warranties and licenses, and managers get reports for audits, budgets and planning.

Every organisation manages IT differently, so we tailor the software to your asset types, approval workflows and reports, and connect it to your help desk, HR and finance tools. It runs in the cloud or on your own server, and you own the code. Need ticketing too? See our <complaint>complaint and ticket management system</complaint> or <contact>talk to us about your IT inventory</contact>.

faqs.title: IT Asset Management Software FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about IT asset and inventory management.

items.q: What is IT asset management software?
items.a: IT asset management (ITAM) software keeps a central record of an organisation's hardware, software, licenses and contracts. It tracks who uses each asset, where it is, its cost and warranty, and its status from purchase to disposal.

items.q: How does IT asset management work?
items.a: Assets are discovered or imported, tagged and registered, then assigned to people and locations. Every change, repair and ticket is logged, alerts flag expiring warranties and licenses, and retired assets are recorded when they are disposed of.

items.q: Is there free or open-source IT asset management software?
items.a: Yes, free and open-source IT asset tools exist and suit small, technical IT teams. Growing organisations often need simpler screens, custom workflows, integrations and dependable support, which a custom system provides without per-asset fees.

items.q: Can I track IT assets with a barcode scanner or mobile phone?
items.a: Yes. You can print barcode or QR asset tags and scan them with a handheld scanner or the mobile app to identify assets, update their location and complete physical audits quickly.

items.q: Does it include asset discovery and help desk integration?
items.a: Yes. Network scanning and agents for Windows, macOS and Linux discover devices and installed software automatically, and IT tickets can be linked to assets through a built-in or connected help desk.

items.q: How much does IT asset management software cost?
items.a: Typical costs are $3,000 to $8,000 for an essential system, $8,000 to $20,000 for advanced features like discovery and license management, and $20,000 or more for enterprise needs. We give a fixed quote after a free consultation.
